notes: `total` counts the stores left after every filter, `min_rating` included.
`rating` is the stores' average star rating. `score` is the PepReviewPro score that `min_rating` and `sort=rating` compare.

`matched_products` is there only when `compound` was passed: up to three of the store's matching products, in stock first, then cheapest. `matched_product_count` beside it counts all of them, so you can tell a store has more.
`ships_to` is empty when a store has not listed its countries. That means unknown, so a `ships_to` filter leaves the store out.
A `compound` outside the library matches nothing and answers an empty list, with `filters.unknown_compound` true.

`filters` echoes what was applied: the compound as the library names it, or null, and the other filters as read, null when not passed. `unknown_compound` is true when `compound` was passed and is not in the library, so an empty list means we do not know the compound rather than that no store has it.

On a partner key, send buyers to `click_url` rather than `website_url` or `page_url`. It goes to the store or product through PepReviewPro, so the store sees the visit came from you. Keys not linked to a partner get no `click_url`.

`click_url` is a `/go/` link on pepreviewpro.com, signed for your partner name. It names the store or product, never a web address, and the destination is read when the buyer clicks. A store that has left the directory sends the buyer to PepReviewPro's directory instead.

To land the buyer on a particular page, add `to` to a `click_url`: `?to=` and the page's address, URL-encoded. `to` is honored only for an http or https address on the store's own host, the host of its `website_url`, or a subdomain of it, ignoring `www.`. Any other `to` is ignored and the link goes where it would without it. The click is credited to you either way.
`profile_url` is the store's PepReviewPro page. On a partner key it carries your partner name as `utm_source`.
On a partner key, each store in a response counts once as served in that store's insights. Until you report what you showed with /partner-events, those reads count as impressions.

notes: `ref` is the store's own id for the product. Prices are in the store's own currency, in major units.
`total` counts every product that matches. An empty list means nothing qualifies. Filters are never dropped to fill it.
A `store` slug that is not a partner store matches nothing.
Each product's `store` carries the store's `website_url`. A `to` on a `click_url` must be on that host.
A product's `click_url` goes to the product page, or to the store when the product is gone by the time it is clicked.

`filters` echoes what was applied: the compound as the library names it, or null, and the other filters as read, null when not passed. `unknown_compound` is true when `compound` was passed and is not in the library, so an empty list means we do not know the compound rather than that no store has it.

On a partner key, send buyers to `click_url` rather than `website_url` or `page_url`. It goes to the store or product through PepReviewPro, so the store sees the visit came from you. Keys not linked to a partner get no `click_url`.

`click_url` is a `/go/` link on pepreviewpro.com, signed for your partner name. It names the store or product, never a web address, and the destination is read when the buyer clicks. A store that has left the directory sends the buyer to PepReviewPro's directory instead.

To land the buyer on a particular page, add `to` to a `click_url`: `?to=` and the page's address, URL-encoded. `to` is honored only for an http or https address on the store's own host, the host of its `website_url`, or a subdomain of it, ignoring `www.`. Any other `to` is ignored and the link goes where it would without it. The click is credited to you either way.
`profile_url` is the store's PepReviewPro page. On a partner key it carries your partner name as `utm_source`.
On a partner key, each store in a response counts once as served in that store's insights. Until you report what you showed with /partner-events, those reads count as impressions.
